_notes: Vanilla 26.3 block use, recorded by Obsidian.AssetGenerator/Java/BlockUseFixtures.java (CaptureFixtures=block_use) on a dedicated server in a flat world of air. Each case's blocks are set around the target without updates; a player standing at 'player' (x, y, z, yaw, pitch) uses the main hand's item (two of it unless 'count' says otherwise, none when 'item' is absent) on the clicked block's face through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn, in the case's game mode (survival by default), sneaking or not, with 'offhand' in the other hand. The area's chunks are forced, so pending block events then run as a tick would run them. Recorded: the result as the packet handler reads it (success swings for others, success_server also for the user, consume doesn't swing); every block within two of the target that changed (dx,dy,dz=state, with the properties that differ from the default); the main hand after; the entities that appeared (items as 'item <id> x<count>'); the sounds, level events ('type offset data') and block events ('block b0 b1 offset') a second player beside the target received; game events within 16 ('name offset source'); statistics awarded ('type value amount'); and the menu type opened. When a menu opened it is closed again, and 'closed' records what closing changed and played.
